condition: Price is extremely extended versus recent moving averages or prior event range and there is no new A/B-grade evidence
allowed_exception: Only tiny tracking position if pre-defined before event
why_it_matters: Avoid buying a fully priced narrative

condition: Same risk cluster exposure is already crowded or multiple highly correlated names would be raised together
required_action: Do not add until exposure falls
why_it_matters: Prevents mistaking diversification for duplicated risk

condition: Thesis is mainly supported by C/D-grade information
why_it_matters: Weak information should not become an investment conclusion

condition: Company narrative improves but FCF or working capital structurally worsens without a delivery explanation
why_it_matters: Narrative without cash conversion can hide execution problems

condition: The thesis requires more than three unverified assumptions to work
why_it_matters: Too many assumptions usually means the edge is imaginary

condition: Unable to write a clear fact that would prove the thesis wrong
why_it_matters: If it cannot be falsified it cannot be managed

condition: Current holding reason is materially different from original buy thesis and drift is not documented
allowed_exception: Document drift and reset thesis before action
why_it_matters: Stops narrative drift from becoming permanent self-justification

condition: Position size would be large relative to daily liquidity or exit window
why_it_matters: Small-cap thesis can be right but untradeable

condition: Upcoming binary event has high expectations and no edge versus consensus
allowed_exception: Tiny tracking only if risk budget allows
why_it_matters: Avoids paying for uncertainty without information edge

condition: Prior similar events in ledger failed versus theme basket and no rule has changed
why_it_matters: Prevents repeating a known weak pattern
